translationRepairs: For military merit he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed as Marquis of Weichang, and did not accept.
For military merit he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed as Baron of Weichang, and did not accept.
s0023’s 賜爵魏昌男 uses the noble rank 男 (baron), not 侯 (marquis); Marquis of Weichang is a rank error and Baron of Weichang matches the Chinese.
At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Xian.
At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Lingquan.
s0054 names 崔㥄悛; 㥄 reads Ling and 悛 Quan, so Cui Lingquan is required and Cui Xian is an unsupported reading of the same characters.

Sheep was Yin; 'horn' written was using a knife; 'Daoist' meant the deposed emperor's childhood name; the princess of Taiyuan had once been a nun, hence 'Auntie'; Yin's Zixian and Tianhe were both the emperor's brothers-in-law.

Sheep was Yin; 'horn' written was using a knife; 'Daoist' meant the deposed emperor's childhood name; the princess of Taiyuan had once been a nun, hence 'Auntie'; Yin, Zixian, and Tianhe were all the emperor's aunts' husbands.

愔子獻、天和皆帝姑夫 lists Yin, Zixian, and Tianhe as all 姑夫; the before invents 'Yin's Zixian' and weakens 姑夫 to brothers-in-law, while the proposal drops 愔 and wrongly turns 姑夫 into the emperor's sisters' husbands.
He also had a clerk call out men's names and by mistake called Lu Shishen Shichen; Shichen spoke up himself, and Yin said, "Master Lu, jade lustrous—therefore the jade radical. From nature it is so."
He also had a clerk call out men's names and by mistake took Lu Shishen for Shichen; Shichen spoke up himself, and Yin said, "Master Lu is jade-lustrous—therefore the jade radical."
誤以盧士深為士琛 is mistaking 士深 for 士琛, and Yin’s reply ends at 所以從玉; the before fuses the mix-up and invents 'From nature it is so,' which the proposed wording removes.

Your servant and Zhan took the weight of state upon ourselves; Heba Ren and Hulu Jin cherished Gao Huan's foundation; we seized Zunyan and his fellows and brought them into the palace. We have not yet executed them; for our presumption we deserve ten thousand deaths."

Your servant and Zhan took the weight of state upon ourselves; Heba Ren and Hulu Jin cherished Emperor Xian's foundation; we seized Zunyan and his fellows and brought them into the palace. We have not yet executed them; for our presumption we deserve ten thousand deaths."
s0151 has 惜獻皇帝基業; the title is 獻皇帝 (Emperor Xian), and substituting the personal name Gao Huan is not what the Chinese says.
candidateDispositions: Noble-rank component, not a person name by itself.
